column1: # Which buildings.label values are dining halls.
# Nothing collected anywhere -- OSM, the directory, the catalog -- tags a
# building's function, so this has to be told rather than derived. Empty by
# design: a guessed building name here would make /v1/dining/forecast quietly
# wrong rather than honestly empty. Fill in real dining hall names as they're
# known, one per line, matching buildings.label exactly (see
# `bun run engine stats` or GET /v1/campus/buildings for the exact strings).
# GET /v1/dining/forecast also takes a `buildings=` query param for a one-off
